title: Dreamy Halloumi & Artichokes
subtitle: with crispy cannellini beans, pumpkin seeds & a lemon-honey dressing
description: A Mediterranean fantasy! Grilled halloumi tops tender artichoke hearts, charred baby tomatoes, mixed green leaves, and cannellini beans — all infused with herbs, honey, and lemon. Warming, invigorating, and quick — who could refuse this stunner?

instructions.title: SWEET 'N SOUR SALAD
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Place the honey in a salad bowl with ¾ of the chopped parsley and a drizzle of oil. Whisk together with some lemon juice to taste — we recommend using lots of lemon for this dressing! Add in the halved artichokes and ½ of the halved baby tomatoes. Season and toss to coat. Submerge the edamame beans in boiling water for 2-3 minutes until plump and heated through. Drain on completion and add to the salad bowl. Set aside to marinate.

instructions.title: POP DEM SEEDS!
instructions.text: Place the pumpkin seeds in a pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until they begin to pop and turn brown. Remove from the pan on completion and set aside to cool.

instructions.title: A PAN OF FRAGRANT DELIGHT
instructions.text: Return the pan to a high heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the drained cannellini beans for 3-4 minutes, shifting occasionally. Stir through the Italian Rub and the remaining tomatoes. Fry for 3-4 minutes until the beans are crispy and the tomatoes are lightly charred. Remove from the pan, cover to keep warm, and set aside.

instructions.title: CRISPY & GOLDEN
instructions.text: Wipe down the pan and return it to a medium heat with another drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the halloumi slabs for 2-3 minutes per side until crispy. Remove from the pan on completion and allow to drain on some paper towel.

instructions.title: PULL IT TOGETHER
instructions.text: Add the warm veggies and the rinsed green leaves to the salad bowl, and toss until evenly distributed. Roughly chop the halloumi into bite-sized chunks and squeeze over any remaining lemon juice to taste.

instructions.title: DINNER IS READY
instructions.text: Dish up the loaded salad and scatter over the golden halloumi. Garnish with the toasted pumpkin seeds and the remaining parsley. Oh what a salad night!
